mostWorthwhile.text: Developing and sharing the lunar hypothesis was most worthwhile: the distinction between a test, supporting evidence and permanent proof made the scientific process clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The prediction and test felt thin because neither the predicted tidal pattern nor the observations were specified.

surprise.text: Looking at the starfield produced the abstract idea of Wonder rather than an observation; it led naturally to a shared question.

arbitrary.text: Pairing the lunar hypothesis with the Moon to produce a prediction had a clear general purpose, but the unspecified prediction made the particular combination feel somewhat arbitrary.

continue.text: I would continue to see what the creatures make of shared knowledge, though I would hope for more concrete examples alongside the mythic abstractions.
